invocation_list.description: A list of remrun command invocations to template out. Each item represents a single remote execution scenario.

invocation_list.items.description: Placeholder for flat items. In this schema, items is a map of field-name to definition as per instructions for list-of-objects, but remrun takes scalar arguments. To strictly follow 'items as a FLAT map field-name -> {type, default, description}' for a list of objects, we define the object structure here. However, the prompt asks for 'items' as a flat map for the *schema* of the list items. Since remrun items are complex (multiple flags + args), we treat the 'item' as an object with specific fields. The 'items' key in schema should define the properties of the objects in the list.
